route_policy: O alvo autoral permanece: Abraço imposto por Kuthulun antes de 1970-12-25, com Bart mortal durante todo M3.01 anterior a 1970. V006/v044 reconciliam fontes apenas em cópias candidatas; master e ciclo atuais não foram atualizados. Uso operacional segue BLOCKED_CONFLICT.

routes.label: forced Embrace before 1970-12-25, with later Cainite adaptation toward the 2010 horizon
preconditions: Use source-candidate M3.01_v006 and state_v044 only for Dramaturge planning; neither is operational.
Before operational use, reconcile the source candidates with master CYCLE/LIVE/history refs and complete all gates.
A future scene must be separately authorized, causally played and persisted.
Record a forced Embrace by Kuthulun before 1970-12-25 only after it actually occurs; it is independent of Bart's consent.
Post-Embrace play must allow meaningful family grief and Cainite adaptation; no automatic survival, torpor, powers, or relationship state.
routes.if_unavailable: Keep operational status BLOCKED_CONFLICT. Do not silently rewrite history, infer an occurred Embrace, inspect hidden truth, or treat a planning prompt as scene permission.
routes.target_window: M3.01 before 1970; forced Embrace by Kuthulun before 1970-12-25; exact dates unknown.
routes.player_rationale: O jogador quer que Bart permaneça mortal durante M3.01 e seja abraçado à força por Kuthulun, independentemente do desejo dele. A proposta dramática inclui construção gradual com mais conflitos Cainitas, derrota diante de Kuthulun, separação familiar e adaptação social. Trata-se de direção autoral, não de evento.

routes.label: possible mortal or non-vampire state at the horizon
preconditions: player approves this alternate target if the legacy vampire target is changed
routes.if_unapproved: This is not the selected authorial target; future changes require an explicit decision and source reconciliation.

routes.label: truthful unfinished, refused, failed, absent or terminal state
preconditions: actual play or player choice causes it and evidence is persisted
routes.if_selected: preserve consequences and do not add plot armor; phase may close without passing the selected target

routes.label: pause or extend if plausibility cannot fit
preconditions: player approves changing target window or treatment of horizon
routes.if_unapproved: keep mismatch visible and block the dependent step

choice_contract.no_default: Silence does not change the authored forced-Embrace target; it also does not create an event, chronology reconciliation, or scene permission.
choice_contract.decision_before: Source reconciliation and operational graduation; any scene still requires separate current-cycle readiness and Narrator permission.
choice_contract.safe_interim_work: Documentary design independent of scene execution, truth-dependent content, and source retiming.
